description:
I'm Aabael, an engineering student interested in electronics, IoT, programming and space exploration. I have experience with ESP32, Arduino, sensors, MQTT and MATLAB/Simulink. I enjoy building practical projects and exploring new technologies.

I'm looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills in Python, AI/ML, web development, data science, UI/UX design or space science. I value teamwork, creativity and learning from others. Let's collaborate and build something innovative.
